title: Canonical synthetic process sampling and contamination clarifications
scope: Resolve canonical-process indexing and observation-noise RNG details before any V2 development hyperparameter selection.

logistic_map.burn_in: apply exactly 500 map updates without recording
logistic_map.subsequent_samples: apply one map update between consecutive returned samples

henon_map.initial_condition_draw: x0 then y0 as two consecutive independent Uniform(-0.5,0.5) draws
henon_map.burn_in: apply exactly 1000 Henon updates without recording
henon_map.first_returned_sample: x component after the 1000th burn-in update
henon_map.subsequent_samples: apply one Henon update between consecutive returned samples

lorenz63.burn_in: apply exactly 5000 RK4 integration steps without recording
lorenz63.first_returned_sample: x component immediately after the 5000th burn-in step
lorenz63.subsequent_samples: apply exactly 10 RK4 steps between consecutive returned samples

relative_observation_noise.implementation_rule: for a fixed process and dgp_seed, each positive noise level reinitializes the contamination RNG with the same offset seed, so the same standardized Gaussian draw is scaled by the requested noise level
relative_observation_noise.noise_free_level: 0.0 returns an exact copy of the clean trajectory
relative_observation_noise.negative_noise_levels: invalid and must raise; they are never interpreted as noise-free
relative_observation_noise.clean_trajectory_reuse: one clean trajectory per process and dgp_seed is shared across all noise levels

custom_suite_conformance.status: V1 equations and frozen V2 custom specifications are semantically aligned for all six custom generators
custom_suite_conformance.v2_rule: implement an isolated V2 synthetic module rather than importing the V1 synthetic module
custom_suite_conformance.reason: freeze exact V2 names, validation, finite checks, std(ddof=0), and noise-level semantics while preserving the locked equations and seed offsets 1000 through 6000

scientific_effect: Implementation clarification only; no development or final performance outcomes were generated or inspected to choose these rules.
